correctness.rationale: Parity bijection gives d_{2a,2b,c}(2t)=H(t)=d(2t+c), H for (a,b,c), all t≥0. Root-of-unity partial fractions for pairwise coprime three generators yield exact H(t+L)-H(t)=t+(L+a+b+c)/2 and Δ(t+L)=Δ(t)+1, L=abc. Hence after explicit U=L max(0,1-min_{r<L}Δ(r)), H is strictly increasing and bounded initial levels give an effective p threshold. The translated ideal and ell,g,n formulas follow by parity. For (a,b,c)=(3,4,7), an exact 84-residue negative-difference table (only indices 0,4,7,28), together with the shift identity and direct low-t counts, leaves only p=0,1,7 non-ray levels; p=0,7 symmetric but p=1 not. Independent rational/integer recurrence checked 84 rows, shift, and 181 thresholds; infinite tail follows from algebra.
